author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Welcome to Hawaii, or as I like to call it: Big Dumb Luxury Island. In this video, we take a look at a $33 million home with a "hotel-sized pool" that is definitely not the size of a hotel , a staircase that is a fantastic choice if you only care about your child’s safety for exactly three steps , and a bedroom that leaves you dangerously exposed to Kayak Perverts.

Also in this video:
- I discover a house on Pee Road and I’m pretty sure I need to lawyer up to protect my trademarked urethra.
- We witness a $45 million "Honolulu Humdinger" featuring Amish Hawaiians who definitely churn their own poi.
- We find a room with so many "conversation nooks" that you have to choose your sofa based on whether you're gossiping or getting a divorce.
- A kitchen that is perfect for time travelers from the 90s who demand a fat CRT TV above their fridge for their RCA cable needs.
- A Jurassic Park-themed entryway that will have you screaming "please don't eat me while I'm on the toilet." 

Hi there
title: The Dumb Luxury Homes of Hawaii
